q: What do the job stages mean?
a: WIP - Processing: being worked on. Sent For Queries: awaiting information from you. Sent For Review / Final Review: with you to review. DWP: Draft Work Paper. RDWP: Revised Draft Work Paper. Job Completed: finished.

q: How often is the dashboard updated?
a: Job movement data refreshes every 15 minutes during business hours.

q: How do I respond to a query?
a: Open the Queries tab on the Delivery Dashboard, select the query and post your reply.

q: Where can I find previous reports?
a: Under Reports in the sidebar: Monthly Connect, Weekly and Invoices.

q: Why can’t I log in from a new network?
a: Access is restricted to approved networks. Submit a request from the login screen or use a one-time login.

q: How do I add a colleague?
a: Contact your account manager or use the Contact Us page and we will set them up.

q: Who do I contact about an invoice?
a: Use Contact Us and choose ‘Billing’ as the topic.
